title: hyoseris lucida subsp. taurina
intro: Hyoseris lucida subsp. taurina, commonly known as Mountain Everlasting, is a rare and short-lived perennial plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a possible treatment for various conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiseptic and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Everlasting include alkaloids, glycosides, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
